scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test:unit: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @bot-bazaar/worker build && node --test tests/configuration/*.test.mjs tests/boundaries/*.test.mjs tests/commands/*.test.mjs tests/digests/*.test.mjs tests/scenarios/*.test.mjs apps/worker/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:contract: node scripts/rust-toolchain.mjs unit && corepack pnpm test:sandbox
scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @bot-bazaar/web dev
scripts.dev:worker: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @bot-bazaar/worker build && corepack pnpm --filter @bot-bazaar/worker start
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm build:packages && eslint apps packages scripts tests eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings 0
scripts.test:simulation: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @bot-bazaar/worker build && node --test apps/worker/test/living-town-replay.test.mjs apps/worker/test/living-town-catchup.test.mjs apps/worker/test/living-town-adapter.test.mjs apps/worker/test/living-town-provider.test.mjs apps/worker/test/living-town-ticks.test.mjs apps/worker/test/living-town-market-event.test.mjs apps/worker/test/living-town-feed.test.mjs apps/worker/test/living-town-stream.test.mjs tests/configuration/living-town-live.test.mjs tests/scenarios/living-town-soak.test.mjs
